messages:
incident-bot: Pager: HIGH - billing.metering.token_drift detected (threshold breach) in prod-us-east - 09:14 UTC. Assigned to @michael_oncall :rotating_light:

michael_oncall: I’m on it. looking at the ingest side first. can someone confirm if this is token increment drift or duplicate emission?

alice_ops: Seeing anomalous +30-60% token delta from emitter-3 -> kafka topic billing_events. offsets are spiking. logs show many retries.

michael_oncall: thanks. kevin, can you run a quick aggregate on token counts vs ledger?

kevin_data: running: 
```
SELECT count_tokens, count_ledger FROM metering.hourly_agg WHERE hour = '2026-03-18T08:00:00Z';
```
Got: emitter_count=2,150,982 ledger_count=1,623,014 -> ~32% delta. digging per-customer now.

tara_eng: I’m tailing emitter-3 pod logs. seeing repeated POST 500s to /emit with retry loop backoff disabled (old client). snippet:
```
2026-03-18T09:11:22Z WARN retrying emit for req_id=abc123 status=500
2026-03-18T09:11:23Z INFO retrying without jitter
```
This would cause duplicates if idempotency header missing.

michael_oncall: Oof. Is this a deploy change to emitter-3? alice, any deploys around 09:00-09:10?

alice_ops: No platform deploys. but emitter-3 restarted twice at 09:06 and 09:09 due to OOM from a spike in batching.

billing-systems: Confirmed overage flags triggered for subset of accounts between 08:55-09:20 UTC. Flagging rule: token delta > 20% triggers alert -> sent billing warning webhook. Customer-facing emails were queued but not yet sent (in staging queue).

jess_cs: Heads up — I’m seeing a couple customers already pinging support about unexpected overage notices (ticket 23456). I’ll hold replies until we confirm root cause.

michael_oncall: Immediate mitigation steps:
- pause automatic overage webhook delivery (billing-systems)
- enable deduplication fallback in the ingest path (tara)
- backfill in safe mode (kevin)
If we can pause webhooks quickly we avoid any more customer notices.

billing-systems: Pausing webhook delivery now. `billing-webhook-queue.pause()` -> done :white_check_mark: (09:22 UTC). No outgoing webhooks will be sent while paused.

tara_eng: I’ve enabled a coarse dedupe filter at the ingress (uuid + payload hash) on emitter-3 and route 3. That should drop obvious duplicates for the next 15m. Applying config: `kubectl patch cm emitter-config -n billing --patch '{...}'`

sre_miguel: I deployed a short-lived ingress rule to reject requests missing `Idempotency-Key` header. Reject rate ~4.1% on emitter-3 — likely impacted clients without newer SDK.

kevin_data: Per-customer delta shows the top 10 affected tenants account for 78% of the spike. They have high-concurrency batched uploads from SDK v0.9. Looks like missing idempotency header + retry loop -> duplicate counts.

amanda_pm: Is customer usage over-reported in the ledger or only in the emitted stream? we need clarity before we touch invoices.

kevin_data: Ledger ingestion pipeline (consumer) has dedupe step but it only runs downstream; current duplicates are in the raw emitter counts. Our canonical ledger count still lags and hasn’t applied backfill. So invoices may not be finalized yet.

michael_oncall: Good. Next:
- keep webhook paused until backfill completes (billing-systems)
- run ledger dedupe + safe backfill for affected window (kevin, ETA 2h)
- send a short internal customer-impact note to CS for triage (jess)

jess_cs: Drafting an internal note: "We’ve paused outgoing overage notifications while we investigate a token-count anomaly affecting a small set of customers. No invoices have been finalized. Support will not send escalation messages until we confirm counts." Will post to #support-ready in 10m.

alice_ops: Tracking: emitter-3 OOMs likely triggered by an old batching config. rolling emitter-3 to upgrade SDK and re-enable jitter on retries. Rolling update started (09:35 UTC).

incident-bot: Incident declared: INCIDENT-2026-03-18-01 - Token counting drift affecting billing overflagging. Severity: P2. Timeline channel created.

michael_oncall: Any customer-visible errors besides overage flags?

jess_cs: A small set got the warning UI banner. no charged invoices yet. Support queue has 7 tickets saying "why am I over limit".

tara_eng: Rolling update completed on emitter-3 (09:48). dedupe rate improved to 0.6%. will monitor for next hour.

kevin_data: Starting safe backfill now for window 08:30-09:30. running de-dup SQL with idempotency heuristics. Estimated 90m to finish.

michael_oncall: Good. Action items assigned:
- kevin_data: run backfill + verify ledger reconciles to emitter counts after dedupe (ETA 90m)
- tara_eng/alice_ops: postmortem for emitter OOM + batching config (ETA doc EOD)
- billing-systems: keep webhooks paused until kevin signs off
- jess_cs: proactive customer comms hold until we verify counts

amanda_pm: Please add a short line for product comms: customers need an explainer on dedupe/backfill and assurance that we will not bill duplicate tokens.

sre_miguel: Monitoring note: set rate alerts lower for emitter pods and added a new dashboard tile for emulator retry spikes.

kevin_data: Backfill finished early (09:58 UTC) — results: ledger_count adjusted to 1,640,120 (previously 1,623,014). Reconciled delta now ~1.9% vs emitter_count. I’ve queued a reconciliation report.

michael_oncall: So residual delta within tolerances. Do we need to unblock webhooks?

billing-systems: Running final check on queued webhooks -> they contain duplicates for 4 customers; we will drop duplicates and replay sanitized notices. Will delay customer-facing messages 15m to ensure sanitization.

jess_cs: Sending approved internal note to #support-ready now. CS will not respond to customers with billing confirmations until we send an official comms.

amanda_pm: Thanks team. Draft customer email: short apology + explain root cause (duplicate emission due to retry/backoff regression), reassurance of no duplicate charges, and steps we took. Will review after reconciliation report.

incident-bot: Incident update: remediation in progress. resources: runbook/billing-dedup-playbook.md assigned.

michael_oncall: Wrapping up: primary cause = emitter retry/backoff regression + missing idempotency header on older SDK. mitigations = ingress dedupe + SDK rollback + backfill. Postmortem owners: tara_eng, kevin_data, alice_ops.

jess_cs: Closing loop with customers once Amanda approves the comms. Tickets will be updated to "monitoring".

michael_oncall: Marking incident as under control at 10:03 UTC. Will keep thread open for final postmortem link. :tada:
